entry.title: Relleno - Curated high quality fast pasta.
entry.summary:
When Relleno reached out to us in January 2025, one thing was already clear: the product was ready. But there was a problem: the brand wasn’t telling that story.
There was no clear voice. No narrative. No system capable of supporting growth.
So we started with the essentials: building its DNA. We defined the strategy, positioning, and tone of voice. And we made a key decision: elevate the brand through codes inspired by Italian fashion.
It wasn’t about aesthetics. It was about strategy. Because gastronomy and fashion share something fundamental: aspiration, sophistication, and culture.
And that’s exactly where Relleno needed to play.
entry.content:
Autor(es): Onmi Design

When Relleno reached out to us in January 2025, one thing was already clear: the product was ready. But there was a problem: the brand wasn’t telling that story. There was no clear voice. No narrative. No system capable of supporting growth. So we started with the essentials: building its DNA. We defined the strategy, positioning, and tone of voice. And we made a key decision: elevate the brand through codes inspired by Italian fashion. It wasn’t about aesthetics. It was about strategy. Because gastronomy and fashion share something fundamental: aspiration, sophistication, and culture. And that’s exactly where Relleno needed to play.


When Relleno approached us in January 2025, the brand had two locations in Madrid and a product with genuine potential to compete at the highest level.

However, there was a clear disconnect: the quality of the product was not being matched by the brand itself.

It lacked a distinct voice, a compelling narrative, and a system capable of creating consistency across every touchpoint.

That’s why the work began with the fundamentals: defining a solid strategic foundation. We built the brand’s DNA from the ground up—covering positioning, values, tone of voice, and brand territory—with the goal of creating a system that could support long-term growth.


From the very beginning, one idea was clear: we wanted to move away from the clichés and visual codes typically associated with Italian pizza and pasta restaurants. While many brands in the category continue to rely on the same aesthetics and visual resources, we developed a completely different direction.


As part of this process, we made a key decision: to build the brand universe around the codes of Italian fashion.

This was not an aesthetic choice, but a strategic one. Italy is globally recognised for excellence in both gastronomy and fashion, and both industries share a language rooted in sophistication, aspiration, and heritage. This approach allowed us to elevate the perception of the product while creating a clearer, more coherent, and more distinctive brand identity.


From there, an intensive implementation process began alongside their internal team. For more than nine months, we translated that brand DNA into every touchpoint: packaging, signage, menus, campaigns, delivery assets, digital content, and countless iterations designed to ensure consistency in every detail.

One of the most significant milestones was the opening of the new Barcelona location. It was a defining moment, as the brand needed to arrive in a new city with its strongest possible expression. We worked closely with Isern Serra Studio to align strategy, design, and architecture from day one, ensuring a cohesive and robust brand experience.


Today, Relleno continues to grow, with new openings across Spain and Portugal.

And while the growth of a brand always depends on many factors, it is especially rewarding to feel that our work has contributed to accelerating that evolution—helping build a brand that is stronger, more recognisable, and better prepared for sustainable growth.

Beyond design, what makes us most proud is having helped create a brand model built on vision, consistency, and a strategic foundation capable of supporting its evolution over time.

entry.title: Hausii Möbel | Brand Identity
entry.summary: Hausii is a Switzerland-based contemporary furniture brand dedicated to creating refined, functional, and timeless pieces for modern living.
entry.content:
Autor(es): Abdu-allah Esmail ✪, Rofidah Bashir ✪

Hausii is a Switzerland-based contemporary furniture brand dedicated to creating refined, functional, and timeless pieces for modern living.

Hausii is a Switzerland-based contemporary furniture brand dedicated to creating refined, functional, and timeless pieces for modern living

We believe that a home is more than just a space — it is a reflection of comfort, balance, and personal identity.Since its inception, Hausii has focused on designing furniture that combines clean minimal aesthetics with exceptional craftsmanship. Every piece is thoughtfully designed and produced using high-quality materials, ensuring durability, comfort, and understated elegance.
Rooted in Swiss values of precision and quality, Hausii places great importance on sustainability. We integrate responsible sourcing, eco-conscious materials, and efficient production processes to create furniture that respects both people and the planet. Our collections are designed to stand the test of time — visually, structurally, and ethically.
At Hausii, form and function go hand in hand. Each design is created to enhance everyday living while maintaining a calm, modern aesthetic that fits seamlessly into contemporary homes.

BRANDING 2024©
LOGO & VISUAL IDENTITY DESIGN.
FURNITURE / INTERIOR / PRODUCT DESIGN
Switzerland
Challenge

The primary challenge for Hausii is to establish a strong and distinctive presence in the highly competitive Swiss furniture market, where minimal and modern wooden furniture is widely available.
As a brand built on quality, sustainability, and timeless design, Hausii must clearly communicate its value beyond aesthetics — highlighting craftsmanship, durability, and responsible production — while remaining accessible and appealing to a broad audience.
Balancing premium positioning with approachability, and sustainability with commercial growth, is essential for Hausii’s long-term success. The challenge lies in differentiating the brand through storytelling, design consistency, and emotional connection, while continuing to grow market share and customer trust.
Solution
Hausii differentiates itself through timeless minimal design, Swiss-quality craftsmanship, and a strong commitment to sustainability. By focusing on high-quality materials, functional elegance, and responsible production, the brand positions its furniture as long-term pieces rather than temporary trends. A consistent visual identity and clear storytelling help build trust, strengthen brand recognition, and support sustainable growth in a competitive market.

entry.title: Curating Homes
entry.summary: Proyecto por Toby Ng con 20 imágenes.
entry.content:
Autor(es): Toby Ng


Curating Homes

Commissioned by The Chinese University of Hong Kong and initiated by Chinachem Group, Curating Homes is a design guide for architects and developers to create Hong Kong residences aligned with the World Health Organization’s concept of Healthy Ageing. 

At the core of the book’s design is a humble yet effective device: the checklist. A universal symbol of structure and clarity, it defines the visual language—translating abstract intentions into actionable steps. Here, the checklist serves as both content and concept, turning each page into a surface of accountability. Solid circles denote essential actions, while open circles indicate best practices—visually distinguishing between the necessary and the ideal.

This idea is made tangible on the cover. Each marked box represents a quiet act of commitment toward better elder living. Wrapped in a translucent plastic jacket, the book is made to last—more than a protective layer, it speaks to practicality, durability, and the everyday resilience required in age-inclusive design. 

Inside, content flows with thoughtful structure. Architectural diagrams, spatial strategies, and real-world examples are paired with articulate layouts. The visual system balances academic rigour with functional clarity, offering not just guidance but a considered experience—where information hierarchy is presented with a refined design voice. 

More than a publication, it is a working tool—meant to be used, annotated, and revisited. A guide designed to live in the hands of those shaping how we age, and where we call home.

See the full case here: https://www.toby-ng.com/works/curating-homes/

entry.title: Creme Curated - Branding and Web Design
entry.summary: Proyecto por Kévin Magalhaes con 17 imágenes.
entry.content:
Autor(es): Kévin Magalhaes




2024
Creme Curated - Branding and Web Design (Curation and E-commerce)

Each piece is a tribute to the subtle beauty that resides in every detail of our daily lives. They celebrate the simplicity of beige shades, inviting everyone to discover the poetry hidden in the images. There are also some nods to Japan, such as the oversized silhouette assumed through the choice of sizes 1 and 2 or the typography associated with the brand's label.

それぞれの作品は、私たちの日常生活の細部に宿る繊細な美しさへのオマージュです。 これらはベージュの色合いのシンプルさを称賛し、画像に隠された詩を発見するよう誰もが誘います。 また、サイズ 1 と 2 の選択によって想定されたオーバーサイズのシルエットや、ブランドのラベルに関連付けられたタイポグラフィーなど、日本への敬意もいくつかあります。

Founder and Creative Director: Kévin Magalhaes​​​​​​​
cremecurated.com





Curation
-

A selection of cream-toned images. A research that gives rise to a feeling, an idea. Inspiration. Through the body, architecture, fashion, design and all the elements that make up our world; that surrounds us. What we see. Curation

クリーム色の画像の選択。 感覚とアイデアを生 み出す研究。 インスピレーション。 身体、建築、 ファッション、デザイン、そして私たちの世界を 構成するすべての要素を通して。 私たちを取り 巻くもの。 私たちが見るもの。 キュレーション。Curation







E-commerce
-

For this web design, I gave importance to the use of empty space. This allows you to create a refined direction while clearly highlighting the content. The reminder of image curation is manifested through the clever organization of the visual elements of the collection grid. I integrated functionality to make it easy for visitors to explore products in an interactive and immersive way.

今回のWebデザインでは、空きスペースの活用を重視しました。 これにより、コンテンツを明確に強調しながら、洗練された演出を作成できます。 画像のキュレーションを思い出させるものは、コレクション グリッドの視覚要素を巧みに構成することによって明らかにされます。 訪問者がインタラクティブかつ没入型の方法で製品を簡単に探索できるようにする機能を統合しました。
